notes.title: Ballex Ver.1.2.5 Update
notes.content:
1. Dozens of user-made maps have been added to the game. You can use leaderboards and ghosts, as well as loading game progress. Enjoy it!
2. The full screen setup has been modified so that you can manually switch to the full screen externally.
3. Fixed some bugs.

Note to Mac users when updating the game:
When updating the game Mac version, some computers may fail to open the game. If this happens, uninstall and reinstall it. 
Don't worry about your save file, it will not be lost.

notes.title: Ballex V1.1.7 update
notes.content:
Update information:
1. Optimized the archiving system to solve part of the problem of Savepoints.
2. Added a “Custom Levels” chapter , which will select some excellent user-made maps into the game. Leaderboards are available for levels in this chapter.
3. Improved the shadow quality, and no more light leakage.
4. The total score of the user information section will be the sum of the highest scores of all levels from Level1 to Level17.

After this update, the game savefiles will be automatically updated to the new version. If there have any abnormal situation, please contact ballex@mushreb.com.
——
When updating the game Mac version, some computers may fail to open the game. If this happens, just uninstall and reinstall it.

notes.title: Ballex Ver.1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
In this update, Ballex has added two new modes: bounce ball mode and 45 degree view mode, which I will introduce respectively.
---------------------
[b]1. Bounce ball mode[/b]
-how to select: at the bottom of the "Get Ready" interface, there is a button "NONE". Click repeatedly until the button displays "BOUNCE" to open the Bounce ball mode.
- what's the feature: in bounce ball mode, all balls are elastic. You need to control the ball bounce pass, the difficulty is much higher than normal mode.
-------
[b]2.45 degree view mode[/b]
- how to select: click the button of "NONE" at the bottom of the "Get Ready" interface repeatedly until the button displays "45DEGREE" to open the 45-degree view mode of this level.
- what features: 45 degrees view mode in the game camera Angle will become 45 degrees, that is to say the original press the direction key "↑" road, now need to press the "←↑" can be over, the difficulty is also higher than the normal mode.
---------------------
This version of the update greatly optimized the physical simulation effect, the controller feel better, in the game is not easy to happen bugs.
Level adjust: adjusted the level 4, 9, 12 where easy to appear problems.
---
By the way, enter MUSH on the main screen and press enter to unlock all levels (caution

If the game is destroyed and cannot be opened after the update, you can uninstall the game and reinstall it. Don't worry, your save file will be preserved.
